mapper.sql: SELECT l.id, l.course_id, l.code, l.name, l.description, l.sort_order, l.created_at, l.updated_at FROM edu.custom_learning_levels l
mapper.select: WHERE l.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY l.sort_order ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT mapping.custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, mapping.learning_outcome_id AS learningOutcomeId FROM edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes mapping JOIN edu.custom_learning_levels level ON level.id = mapping.custom_learning_level_id WHERE level.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY mapping.custom_learning_level_id, mapping.learning_outcome_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.custom_learning_levels (id, course_id, code, name, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.custom_learning_levels SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
